Package models.academic

Class Course

java.lang.Object
models.academic.Course
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Course>
public class Course extends Object implements Serializable, Comparable<Course>
Represents a university course. A course can have multiple instructors, enrolled students, lessons, and marks. Students may not exceed 21 credits in total registration.
